create_inventory_location.description: Create a location to ship from. An offer cannot be published without one.
create_inventory_location.name: create_inventory_location

parameters.description: Your own key for this location, e.g. main-warehouse.
parameters.name: merchant_location_key

parameters.description: Display name for the location.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Postal or ZIP code.
parameters.name: postal_code

parameters.description: City.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: State or province.
parameters.name: state_or_province

parameters.description: Street address.
parameters.name: address_line1

create_offer.description: Create an unpublished offer for a SKU on one marketplace. Publish it afterwards to create the live listing.
create_offer.name: create_offer

parameters.description: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item. Use 'List inventory items' to find one.
parameters.name: sku

parameters.description: The eBay marketplace to list on.
parameters.name: marketplace_id

parameters.description: eBay leaf category id, e.g. 9355. Find it by looking at a similar live listing, or in eBay's category lookup.
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.description: Listing price, e.g. 19.99.
parameters.name: price

parameters.description: Currency for the price (3-letter code).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: How many units this offer makes available.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: The inventory location this offer ships from.
parameters.name: merchant_location_key

parameters.description: Fixed price or auction.
parameters.name: listing_format

parameters.description: Listing description. Falls back to the inventory item's description when empty.
parameters.name: listing_description

parameters.description: Shipping policy to apply. Required to publish.
parameters.name: fulfillment_policy_id

parameters.description: Payment policy to apply. Required to publish.
parameters.name: payment_policy_id

parameters.description: Return policy to apply. Required to publish.
parameters.name: return_policy_id

create_or_replace_inventory_item.description: Create an inventory item for a SKU, or replace it if the SKU already exists. An inventory item is the product record; an offer turns it into a listing.
create_or_replace_inventory_item.name: create_or_replace_inventory_item

parameters.description: Your own SKU for this product. Replaces the item if the SKU already exists.
parameters.name: sku

parameters.description: Product title shown on the listing (max 80 characters).
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Full product description. Accepts basic HTML.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The item's condition.
parameters.name: condition

parameters.description: How many units are available to ship.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: Publicly reachable image URLs. eBay requires at least one image before an offer can be published.
parameters.name: image_urls

parameters.description: Product brand. Supply with MPN, or leave both empty.
parameters.name: brand

parameters.description: Manufacturer part number. Supply with Brand.
parameters.name: mpn

parameters.description: Item specifics, as an object of name to value, for example {"Type": "Tablet", "Screen Size": "10 in"}. Most eBay categories require their own; an offer missing one is rejected when its fees are previewed or it is published.
parameters.name: aspects

parameters.description: Language the product details are written in.
parameters.name: locale

delete_offer.description: Delete an offer. Withdraw it first if it is published.

update_offer.description: Change an offer's price, quantity or description. Other settings are preserved.
update_offer.name: update_offer

parameters.description: The offer's eBay id. Comes from 'Create offer' or 'List offers for a SKU'.
parameters.name: offer_id

parameters.description: New price, e.g. 24.99. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: price

parameters.description: Currency for the new price (3-letter code).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: New available quantity. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: New listing description. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: listing_description

update_price_quantity.description: Change a SKU's available quantity, an offer's price, or both. Changing a price needs the offer id, because price belongs to the offer rather than to the inventory item.

parameters.description: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item. Use 'List inventory items' to find one.
parameters.name: sku

parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: New price, e.g. 19.99. Requires the offer id below.
parameters.name: price

parameters.description: Currency for the new price (3-letter code).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The offer whose price to change. Required with price.
